{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
print(sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum())

# Filter for completed orders and LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Calculate the mean revenue for these orders
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
